notes: Company context: developer tools startup building an in-product code assistant and contextual search for docs. SMB, fast iteration cycle. Open to hosted API only for now.
Primary workload: interactive chat completions in editor (code + natural language), plus embeddings for doc search and reranking for suggestion ranking.

Traffic profile: current estimate 2-6k monthly active users, peaks ~20 reqs/sec during daytime for beta; average session 3 messages; median tokens per message ~120; goal is sub-600ms first-token for chat at p95.

Model questions raised on call: Llama variants (Llama-2-13B), Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B (and quantized variants). They asked: 'Which strikes the best balance for code & chat quality vs token cost? Any LLM you recommend for 1) low cost but acceptable code completions 2) highest accuracy for tricky code prompts?'

Cost sensitivity: moderate-high. If a smaller model gives 60-70% of quality at 30-40% of cost they'd prefer tuning it. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching/quantization) if it preserves quality.
Safety / behavior: concerned about hallucinations in code generation. Asked about model evals, regression alerts tied to prompt sets and ability to pin a model per route.

Latency concerns: been burned by high variance. Wants guidance on expected latency differences between Mistral-7B hosted vs Llama-2-13B-hosted (non-quantized) and what quantized Qwen looks like on p95.

POC ask: run hosted POC comparing Mistral-7B-instruct, Llama-2-13B-chat, Qwen-7B-Chat-4bit across 200 prompt eval set. Measure: top-1 accuracy on unit tests, harmful output checks, cost per 1k tokens, p50/p95 latency. 30-day window.
Quote / paraphrase from engineering lead: 'We prefer not to manage infra yet — hosted API is ideal, but we need clear guidance on picking a baseline model and how to scale cost-efficiently.'
Requested artifacts: short model recommendation one-pager (Llama vs Mistral vs Qwen), sample SDK snippet for quickstart, cost calculator for expected monthly spend at 10k daily tokens.
